### Hide and Seek - The Crosswalk Devotional - October 6
Author: Megan J. Conner
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/hide-and-seek-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:29
Points:
- Hardship, disappointment, and sin frequently cause people to pull away and hide from the Lord.
- In seasons of distress, people often feel isolated and falsely believe God is keeping distant.
- God never abandons His children in difficult times; He remains near and desires to be found.
- Finding the Lord requires seeking Him wholeheartedly rather than offering Him divided affections.
- Believers should examine what they prioritize and step out of hiding into God's loving arms.

### Knowing God’s Heart
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/knowing-gods-heart
Passage: Deuteronomy 4:29-30
Points:
- Humans are created for relationship and have an innate desire to be understood.
- Acquiring superficial head knowledge about God falls short of truly knowing His character and heart.
- Believers come to know God more intimately by walking faithfully with Him and reading Scripture.
- Hardship and distress serve as prompts to turn back and listen to the voice of the Lord.
- God makes a faithful promise that those who earnestly seek Him with their whole soul will find Him.
